findings.title: GBJ source-build receipt is stale and required build outputs are missing
evidence: The receipt records power_entry_unit.ato sha256 d31c214932e7865e9b5e2064adeffd72d064c9898fc9665cac9fd6e98bb2b753, while the bundled file hashes to 5612d4e45695472c6e3870e231bb34377e68a4332e8f28d83eee0a94707cbe0c.
ALTERNATE-REBUILD-REQUIRED.md says the copied receipt is only provenance for the starting graph and that the GBJ source compiler/build must be rerun.

source-manifest.json records status compiled-atopile-and-native-generated and input hashes for default.csv/default.net, but source-build/build/default.csv and source-build/build/default.net are not bundled.
findings.risk: The source manifest and generated evidence cannot be reproduced or proven to come from the current GBJ source. A source-bound result is therefore not established.
findings.fix: Run the Atopile GBJ source build after the final source edits; regenerate and hash the native outputs, refresh source-manifest/resolved-components/build-receipt, and bundle the referenced build outputs or remove their references.

findings.title: alternate-gbj source manifest contains contradictory bridge polarity maps
evidence: full_bridge.nets maps U1 pin 1=minus and pin 4=plus, retaining the old GBU polarity.
The routed PCB and KiCad netlist are correct, so the defect is the internal manifest contradiction and whichever consumer selects full_bridge.
findings.risk: A harness or downstream source consumer using full_bridge can invert the GBJ rectifier polarity while the board and schematic still appear clean.
findings.fix: Regenerate the complete manifest from one authoritative GBJ graph, update full_bridge to the same pin map, and add a consistency assertion that all manifest bridge maps equal the KiCad netlist and PCB pads.

findings.title: Generic extraction filenames retain stale or wrong-variant evidence
evidence: alternate-gbj/evidence/native.json and manufacturing.json bind board_sha256 8a464486017deb4fdbc027fa05c2f8cdd66533569ccd10727137f8b6c12a99d8 (same-package-3mm), not the alternate board fd624e37be053e5140256fcbcb8ab84e330b42d1fbff3a01f92fa8d8a205447b; native.json explicitly labels evidence_binding.candidate_variant as variants/same-package-3mm.

shaped-pad-entry/evidence/native.json has final board hash c0401ca80cda70ce0beec3d18a31c77fc6396f3ac51b54e0bcaed11fd4494cd0 but evidence_binding.candidate_variant remains variants/same-package-3mm; manufacturing.json reports 250 tracks versus manufacturing-fresh.json's 254 after the shaped transitions.
Fresh files exist beside these generic files, but the generic names are the ones a default consumer will naturally select.
findings.risk: A reviewer or automated consumer can silently evaluate a prior candidate or pre-edit geometry while believing it is final evidence.
findings.fix: Quarantine stale records under an explicitly historical path or add a machine-readable stale marker; make variants.json and all consumers select only fresh files and reject any board-hash/evidence-binding mismatch.
